name: Aniyome -Miboujin-
source:
When Mitsuru was young, his older brother took care of him and he viewed him like a foster father. One day, his brother suddenly dies, leaving behind his wife, Kitadate Yura and their newborn daughter. Since his brother took care of him all the time, he wants to return that to his family and support his widowed sister-in-law and niece, but after some time he starts to view Yura as a woman and he wants to start a family with her.

-umwork
translation: 充从小由哥哥照顾，把他视为养父。某天，哥哥突然去世，留下妻子北馆由良和刚出生的女儿。由于哥哥一直照顾充，他希望回报这个家庭，支持守寡的嫂子和侄女；但过了一段时间，他开始把由良当作女人看待，并想和她建立家庭。
